AbsencePattern.description:
Fire once when nothing has passed the filter for ``within`` since the last envelope did.

Only scopes that have been seen can go quiet. Time passes with every envelope in the log,
whether or not it passes the filter.
AbsencePattern.title: AbsencePattern

ActionRef.description: The action a rule runs, by name, and the params the rule passes it.
ActionRef.title: ActionRef

AgentActor.description: An agent or graph running an action for one firing of a rule.
AgentActor.title: AgentActor

AllFilter-Input.description: Envelopes that match every filter in ``of``.
AllFilter-Input.title: AllFilter

AllFilter-Output.description: Envelopes that match every filter in ``of``.
AllFilter-Output.title: AllFilter

AnyFilter-Input.description: Envelopes that match at least one filter in ``of``.
AnyFilter-Input.title: AnyFilter

AnyFilter-Output.description: Envelopes that match at least one filter in ``of``.
AnyFilter-Output.title: AnyFilter

ArchiveRule.description: Archive a stored rule, and cancel its unfinished runs.
ArchiveRule.title: ArchiveRule

CancelRun.description: Cancel a run that has not finished, stopping its action if it is running.
CancelRun.title: CancelRun

Causation.description: What caused an event that a run emitted, and how deep its causal chain is.
Causation.title: Causation

ChainTarget.description: Feedback on a causal chain: everything one triggering event led to.
ChainTarget.title: ChainTarget

CommandFrame.description:
A client's command, with an id that correlates it with its result.

``command_id`` is also an idempotency key: the server deduplicates repeated ids.
CommandFrame.title: CommandFrame

CommandResult.description: The result of one command frame.
CommandResult.title: CommandResult

Condition-Input.description: A rule's ``when``: a filter, and optionally dedupe, a pattern and a throttle.
Condition-Input.title: Condition

Condition-Output.description: A rule's ``when``: a filter, and optionally dedupe, a pattern and a throttle.
Condition-Output.title: Condition

CountPattern.description: Fire when ``at_least`` envelopes pass within ``within``. A firing consumes them.
CountPattern.title: CountPattern

Dedupe.description: Drop an envelope whose ``key`` fields were already seen within ``within``.
Dedupe.title: Dedupe

EachPattern.description: Fire for every envelope that passes the filter.
EachPattern.title: EachPattern

Envelope.description: A stored event with its position and attribution. Its shape is also the wire shape.
Envelope.title: Envelope

EvaluationError.description: A rule could not evaluate one envelope.
EvaluationError.title: EvaluationError

EvaluatorActor.description: An evaluator: a judge or decision model whose verdicts are recorded as feedback.
EvaluatorActor.title: EvaluatorActor

Event.description:
Base class for event types.

Subclass it through an abstract base that declares a namespace with ``event_namespace=``,
and give it ordinary Pydantic fields. Events are facts, so they are immutable, and unknown
fields are rejected so that a producer's typo fails loudly.
Event.title: Event

ExternalAgentActor.description:
An agent outside reflexr, connected over MCP.

A person who connects a client with their own credentials acts through it: their actor is
its ``on_behalf_of``, and an application's ``authorize`` checks it as them, as artifactr's
does. A client with credentials of its own acts for no one.
ExternalAgentActor.title: ExternalAgentActor

FeedbackGiven.description: A person or an evaluator judged a run, a firing or a causal chain.
FeedbackGiven.title: FeedbackGiven

FieldError.description: One problem FastAPI found with a request's parameters or body.
FieldError.title: FieldError

FiringTarget.description: Feedback on one firing: whether the rule should have fired.
FiringTarget.title: FiringTarget

GiveFeedback.description: Give typed feedback on a run, a firing or a causal chain.
GiveFeedback.title: GiveFeedback

InstallRule.description: Install a stored rule: its first version, or the next version of an archived one.
InstallRule.title: InstallRule

OnFilter.description: Envelopes whose event is one of ``types``.
OnFilter.title: OnFilter

PredicateFilter.description:
Envelopes whose event the registered Python predicate ``name`` accepts.

An escape hatch for what the other filters cannot express. Predicates must be pure.
PredicateFilter.title: PredicateFilter

Publish.description: Publish an event. Publishing an ``id`` already in the log appends nothing.
Publish.title: Publish

PublishBatch.description: Events to publish atomically and in order, optionally joining a causal chain.
PublishBatch.title: PublishBatch

PublishItem.description: One event to publish, with an optional id for idempotency.
PublishItem.title: PublishItem

PublishedOutcome.description: What publishing did: the event's position, and whether it was already there.
PublishedOutcome.title: PublishedOutcome

RecordedOutcome.description: Where a fact the command recorded, such as feedback, was appended.
RecordedOutcome.title: RecordedOutcome

Refused.description:
The body of a refused request.

``detail`` is the rejection, the message of a resolver's refusal, or the problems FastAPI
found with the request.
Refused.title: Refused

RejectionDetail.description: A rejection, as REST sends it: its ``type``, its ``message`` and its typed details.
RejectionDetail.title: RejectionDetail

ReplayRule.description: Reset a rule to evaluate the log again, rebuilding its state or firing again.
ReplayRule.title: ReplayRule

RetryPolicy.description: How a failed run is retried: exponential backoff, up to ``max_attempts`` attempts.
RetryPolicy.title: RetryPolicy

Rule-Input.description: When ``when`` holds for a scope, run ``then``.
Rule-Input.title: Rule

Rule-Output.description: When ``when`` holds for a scope, run ``then``.
Rule-Output.title: Rule

RuleArchived.description: A stored rule was archived, and its unfinished runs cancelled.
RuleArchived.title: RuleArchived

RuleErrored.description: A rule could not evaluate one envelope; it is dead-lettered for that rule alone.
RuleErrored.title: RuleErrored

RuleFired.description: A rule's condition held for one scope; a run of its action was created.
RuleFired.title: RuleFired

RuleInstalled.description:
A stored rule was installed or updated: its new version, whole, and where it came from.

The facts are a stored rule's history: the version that fired a run is the latest one
before its firing.
RuleInstalled.title: RuleInstalled

RuleOutcome.description: A rule's progress after the command reset it.
RuleOutcome.title: RuleOutcome

RuleProgress.description: Where a rule is in a workspace's log, stored with its cursor.
RuleProgress.title: RuleProgress

RuleReset.description: A rule's state was reset, because its definition changed or it was replayed.
RuleReset.title: RuleReset

RuleStatus.description: A rule's progress in a workspace.
RuleStatus.title: RuleStatus

RuleVersionOutcome.description: A stored rule's version after the command changed it, or found it changed already.
RuleVersionOutcome.title: RuleVersionOutcome

Run.description: One firing's action: its status, attempts, and a graph's latest checkpoint.
Run.title: Run

RunDeadLettered.description: A run exhausted its retries, or failed in a way retrying cannot fix.
RunDeadLettered.title: RunDeadLettered

RunOutcome.description: A run after the command changed it.
RunOutcome.title: RunOutcome

RunProgressed.description: A graph run completed a step and saved a checkpoint.
RunProgressed.title: RunProgressed

RunRequeued.description: Someone made a run runnable again. The envelope's actor records who.
RunRequeued.title: RunRequeued

RunRetrying.description: An attempt failed, and the run will be tried again.
RunRetrying.title: RunRetrying

RunSkipped.description: A run was skipped without completing, unblocking its scope.
RunSkipped.title: RunSkipped

RunStarted.description: An attempt of a run began.
RunStarted.title: RunStarted

RunTarget.description: Feedback on one run: a workflow execution.
RunTarget.title: RunTarget

Schedule.description:
When to publish ticks, and into which workspaces.

Give ``every`` or ``cron``, not both::

    Schedule(name="heartbeat-check", every=timedelta(seconds=30))
    Schedule(name="weekday-standup", cron="0 9 * * mon-fri", timezone="Europe/Oslo")
Schedule.title: Schedule

ScheduleStatus.description: When a schedule last ticked in a workspace, and when it ticks next.
ScheduleStatus.title: ScheduleStatus

Scope.description: The event fields that partition a rule's state and ordering. None: the whole workspace.
Scope.title: Scope

SequencePattern-Input.description:
Fire when envelopes match ``steps`` in order, all within ``within`` of the first.

An envelope that matches the first step while a sequence is in progress (but not the step
it is waiting for) starts the sequence again from it, so the latest start counts.
SequencePattern-Input.title: SequencePattern

SequencePattern-Output.description:
Fire when envelopes match ``steps`` in order, all within ``within`` of the first.

An envelope that matches the first step while a sequence is in progress (but not the step
it is waiting for) starts the sequence again from it, so the latest start counts.
SequencePattern-Output.title: SequencePattern

SkipRun.description: Give up on a waiting or dead-lettered run.
SkipRun.title: SkipRun

SourceActor.description: A system that publishes events, such as a monitoring service or a webhook.
SourceActor.title: SourceActor

SystemActor.description: reflexr itself (the reactor, schedules), or the application acting on its own behalf.
SystemActor.title: SystemActor

Throttle.description: Allow at most ``at_most`` firings per scope in any period of ``per``.
Throttle.title: Throttle

Tick.description: A schedule's tick. Ticks also move rules' clocks forward in quiet workspaces.
Tick.title: Tick

UpdateRule.description: Replace an active stored rule with a new version, reset if its condition or scope changed.
UpdateRule.title: UpdateRule

UserActor.description: A person, identified by the host application's user id.
UserActor.title: UserActor

WhereFilter.description:
Envelopes whose event field ``field`` compares with ``value`` by ``op``.

A missing field matches nothing, except ``exists`` with ``value=False``.
WhereFilter.title: WhereFilter

WorkspaceRule.description: One of a workspace's rules: a code rule, or the current version of an active stored one.
WorkspaceRule.title: WorkspaceRule

_OtherEvent.description:
An event of the application's, or one this version doesn't know, in JSON Schema only.

Events are validated through the registry, by their ``type``; this only describes the wire.
_OtherEvent.title: OtherEvent

get.description: Return the rules registered in code, which every workspace evaluates.

Return the registered schedules that tick in the caller's tenant.

A schedule that targets particular workspaces lists only the tenant's own, so no
tenant sees another's ids; one that targets none of them is left out.

post.description: Submit one command. The body is the same frame as over the WebSocket.

schema.title: Response 400 Post Command Workspaces  Workspace Id  Commands Post

Response 404 Post Command Workspaces  Workspace Id  Commands Post
Response 409 Post Command Workspaces  Workspace Id  Commands Post
Response 422 Post Command Workspaces  Workspace Id  Commands Post

get.description: Return the envelopes rules could not evaluate, oldest first.

schema.title: Response List Dead Letters Workspaces  Workspace Id  Dead Letters Get

get.description:
Return a page of the log, optionally of some event types. ``type`` may repeat.

The window is ``after_seq < seq < before_seq``. ``limit`` returns its first envelopes,
``last`` its last ones, oldest first either way.

schema.title: Response List Events Workspaces  Workspace Id  Events Get

post.description: Publish one event, or a batch in order: all of them, or none.

schema.title: Response Post Events Workspaces  Workspace Id  Events Post

get.description:
Return the status of each of the workspace's rules, code rules first.

A status is the rule's origin, a stored rule's version, whether the rule is enabled,
and its cursor, lag, generation and dead letters.

schema.title: Response List Rule Status Workspaces  Workspace Id  Rules Get

get.description: Return one of the workspace's rules, with a stored rule's version and provenance.

Return a stored rule's versions, oldest first: its install and archive facts.

An archived rule keeps its history, and a rule never stored has none.

schema.title: Response Get Rule History Workspaces  Workspace Id  Rules  Rule  History Get
Response List Runs Workspaces  Workspace Id  Runs Get

get.description: Return a run, with its attempts, last error and checkpoint.
Return when each schedule targeting this workspace last ticked and ticks next.

schema.title: Response List Schedule Status Workspaces  Workspace Id  Schedules Get
